name: rss
description: New entries from the feeds you list (RSS, Atom and JSON Feed): blogs, podcasts, status pages, YouTube channels, Reddit inbox feeds. Read-only: it only fetches the feeds.

requires.help: Create a plain text file with one feed address per line and save it there. Lines starting with # are notes, and "name = address" gives a feed your own name. Example line: Example blog = https://blog.example.com/feed.xml. Details: extractors/rss/README.md. Treat a feed address that contains a private key (such as a Reddit inbox feed) like a password.
